title: Evolveborn
tagline: Start as a wisp, devour what you hunt, rebuild your body, and heal a world.
stateNote: A Godot browser action RPG with a story update (v0.3). It needs WebGL 2.
problem: Most creature-growth games hand you upgrades. Here you hunt eight species, take their adaptations, and fit them into a body with limited capacity, so every build is a trade-off.
audience: Players who like action RPGs with a build-your-body twist.
contribution: It is my project, made in Godot and GDScript for the browser. The v0.3 'Luma's Garden' update adds five memory-shrine puzzles, a journal and two endings, per the README.
worksToday: Hunt eight species, devour their adaptations and evolve, per the README.
Saves stay in your browser; no account is needed.
limitations: I checked that the title menu loads, not the full game.
The README also mentions a Windows build; I haven't checked it.
Clearing site data clears your save.

involve.headline: Hungry for feedback.
asks: Tell me which adaptation felt the most fun.
If you do Godot, I'd like to compare notes on web performance.

disclosure.note: Public repository. This page is written from its README and the public build.
